title: Magnetic Field Modulation Pillow for Insomnia Clinical Trial
brief_summary: This interventional study was designed to explore the clinical effect of magnetic field modulation system on insomnia patients and provide a new solution for insomnia treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1.18 to 65 years old. 2.Primary Insomnia

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Secondary Insomnia
2. Pilot, high-altitude operator
3. Pregnant, lactating women
4. Patients with serious disease
5. The researchers believe that the candidates are not eligible
